decision.reason: The M724 defects are closed, but the success receipt and seal do not revalidate runner, contract, and capture against their frozen authority SHAs after the long capture.

P0.title: Post-capture terminal validation rebinds to mutable current files instead of the frozen launch authority
evidence: Runner/contract/capture are compared with the frozen expected SHAs only before the idle loop and capture.
After capture, no EXPECTED_RUNNER/EXPECTED_CONTRACT/EXPECTED_CAPTURE comparison occurs before RUN_COMPLETE and seal.

The terminal validator compares payload m714_script_sha256 and m714_contract_sha256 only to sha(capture_path) and sha(contract_path) at terminal time; it loads contract as c but never compares against c.identity.m714_script.sha256.

The capture computes m714_script_sha256 and m714_contract_sha256 from current disk files after M366 returns, without requiring them to equal the values validated at capture start. RUN_COMPLETE similarly hashes the current runner/contract/capture.
P0.risk: An accidental or concurrent edit during the long GPU capture can yield a fully sealed terminal result whose cited source/contract/runner identities were never authorized by this review and may not be the objects whose in-memory semantics produced the payload.
P0.required_fix: Immediately after capture and before terminal receipt/seal, re-check the current runner, contract and capture SHA against the same frozen expected values used at launch; also require payload identity to equal the contract-pinned capture SHA and start-observed contract SHA. Any drift must quarantine the staging tree. Refresh runner SHA and rehammer.

claim_boundary: This FAIL review authorizes no runner execution, remote/GPU capture, attempt/result creation, M714 pattern result, executable cycle, real-output miter, RTL/VCS, Synopsys PPA/energy, accuracy, system speedup, or paper headline. M724 repair closure and the static mathematical/accounting facts remain admitted only as source-review findings.
